notes: Added missing schema/contract and core orchestration depth stories.

stories.title: Define EvaluateCare Facade Input/Output Contracts
stories.description: Define and enforce strict Pydantic schemas for evaluate care facade inputs and outputs, covering clinical trials search parameters and provider detail lookup responses to ensure consistency with tool_router validation and downstream rendering.

stories.title: Implement Robust Orchestration Logic with Fallback Handling
stories.description: Enhance evaluate_care_facade to coordinate clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service with structured fallback handling for partial failures (e.g., missing trials, API timeouts), ensuring graceful degradation and informative responses.

stories.title: Standardize Response Formatting and Metadata Enrichment
stories.description: Add consistent response formatting within the facade including metadata such as source attribution, travel distance, and validation status, ensuring compatibility with URL guardian and debug logging systems.
